name: congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia due to STAR deficency
description: Congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia (CLAH) is one of the most severe forms of congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH) characterized by severe adrenal insufficiency and sex reversal in males.
